hotels.title: Boutique Tuscany Vineyard Escape with Daily Breakfast & Wine Tasting
hotels.description: Stay among the grapes and make your dreams of the Tuscan countryside a reality at this boutique retreat, set on 20 hectares of verdant vineyards and olive groves in the heart of Chianti. Surrounded by vineyard-cloaked valleys and rolling hills, Agriturismo Relais Campiglioni is a charming country house that offers the perfect escape from the bustle of Italy's cities, while keeping Florence, Siena and Arezzo within easy reach whenever the urge to explore takes hold. This rustic yet elegant farmhouse is made for slow, indulgent days. Take a dip in one of three saltwater swimming pools or simply stretch out on the sun terrace with a glass of something local. Wake each morning to a daily breakfast before setting out into the Tuscan landscape, and round off your afternoons with a tasting of the property's own wines and olive oils for a true taste of la dolce vita.
